title: Lag-1 parity-count transition memory
hypothesis: The odd-count of the immediately preceding 5-of-40 draw contains incremental information about the odd-count of the next draw, beyond the exact combinatorial Hypergeometric(40,20,5) marginal distribution.

excluded_appended_row.reason: The official VinciCasa November 2026 archive still lists contest 314 as In programmazione/In attesa at preregistration time. A third-party page reports a result, but third-party-only evidence is not accepted for the canonical dataset.

definition.feature: A_t = number of odd values in draw D_t

models.M1: One-step categorical shrinkage p1(k|a)=[alpha*q0(k)+C_a(k)]/[alpha+N_a], where C_a counts only prior transitions with previous odd-count a and target odd-count k.
models.parameter_selection: None. alpha is fixed before scoring. No temperature, state merging, subgroup selection, or parameter tuning.

walk_forward.strict_prior_rule: For target draw index t, only draws[0..t-1] are read. Training transitions j=1..t-1 use feature A_(j-1) and outcome A_j; exactly t-1 prior transitions are available.
walk_forward.split_rule: Chronological 60%/20%/20% using integer counts 1861/620/621; split boundaries are fixed before scoring.

inference.primary_comparison: M1 versus M0 on historical Blind OOS.
inference.gain_definition: Baseline loss minus model loss; positive is better.
inference.multiple_testing: Holm correction across the two preregistered Blind OOS endpoints. No post-hoc state-specific tests.
inference.exploratory_family_caveat: This within-experiment correction does not account for the full history of Q00-Q108 experiments; historical Blind OOS is not a virgin holdout.

acceptance_checks: CSV schema, chronology, unique dates and 5 distinct integers in 1..40
first 3403 rows reproduce the pinned prefix blob
the appended 2026-11-10 row is excluded from every calculation
all target cutoffs are strictly prior and use exactly t-1 training transitions
all M0/M1 probability vectors are finite, positive and normalized
future-mutation invariance at nine deterministic cutoffs
synthetic state sensitivity and no-support fallback
report and ledger reproduce byte-for-byte from the persisted runner
